description.value:
Choose a programming language. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Overclock Gear] action. You gain your programming language's overclock boost benefits as if you were a 1st-level technomancer.

You cast spells like a technomancer, gaining a spell database with two common arcane cantrips of your choice. You gain access to the Cast a Spell activity. You're trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your key spellcasting attribute for technomancer archetype spells is Intelligence, and they're arcane technomancer spells.
